notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 54-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.82, creatinine 0.79, hemoglobin 12.7, platelets 318, sodium 138, wbc 9.2; vitals dbp 68-72, heart_rate 74-79, map 86-90, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16, sbp 121-127, spo2 96-97, temp 36.8-37
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 0.82, hemoglobin 12.6, platelets 316, sodium 139, wbc 8.6; vitals dbp 67-72, heart_rate 75-80, map 85-90, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 121-127, spo2 96-98, temp 36.7-37
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 54-year-old female, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed.
